senses.gloss:
हेष् हेष् [cf. rt. ह्रेष्], cl. 1. A. हेषते,
जिहेषे, हेषितुम्, to neigh (as a horse),
whinny; to make any inarticulate sound, bray, roar;
[cf. Gr. γίννος; Lat. hinnio (for hisnio), hin-
nulus.]

हेष, अस्, m. neighing; a neigh, braying, roaring.
—हेष-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. making a neighing
or roaring sound, roaring, (in Ṛg-veda III. 26, 5.
said of lions; according to Sāy. हेष-क्रतवः =
हेषा-रवस्य क्रतुः करणं येषां ते.)
हेषा, f. neighing (of horses), whinnying, braying.

हेषस्, Ved. (probably) neighing, braying; sound-
ing, (in Ṛg-veda X. 89. 12. Sāy. explains हेषसा
by शब्द-कारिण्या हेत्या.)

हेषाय, Nom. A. हेषायते, -यितुम्, to neigh,
whinny.

हेषित, अम्, n. a neigh or any similar inarticulate
sound, neighing, whinnying.
हेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, neighing; (ई), m. a horse.
